emergencyStop().notice: Kill-switch: bricks the route so no stale config can execute.

executeArb(uint256).notice: Kick off an Aave V3 flash loan against the stored route. Post-callback we verify realized profit >= minProfit or revert the WHOLE tx.

isExecuting().notice: P1-2: true ONLY inside an in-flight flash-loan callback. rescueFunds and sweepProfit refuse to run while set, so borrowed assets can never be drained mid-arb. One warm SSTORE read + one cold write per arb ≈ 22k gas.

rescueFunds(address,address,uint256).notice: Owner-only rescue for stuck assets (airdrops, dust, mis-sent funds). token == address(0) => native ETH. Never callable by non-owner.

revokeAllowances().notice: Kill-switch companion (P0-2): zero the max-approvals granted to the route pools in setRoute(). Called by the bot's emergencyStop BEFORE the process dies, so a leaked key can never drain via stale approvals. Safe mid-flight? No — guarded like rescueFunds: borrowed assets must be repaid first; reverting here during a callback would break repayment.

sweepProfit(address,address).notice: Sweep ONLY realized profit to `to`. Invariant that makes this "pure profit": contract holds no native gas capital and repays the full flash-loan principal inside executeArb, so the resting ERC20 balance of `profitToken` equals accumulated profit. Gas capital lives in the bot EOA and is structurally unreachable from this function.

sweepToCold().notice: Convenience sweep of the configured profit token to the cold wallet.
